title: Enterprise Support: Supplemental baseline export hours for physical-quantity reconciliation
content:
Enterprise Support — Supplemental baseline export hours for physical-quantity reconciliation.

## Decision basis

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Sum completed supplemental support spending export quantity, in vCPU-hours, for the same original charge and period; primary missing-export records and rejected records do not enter this baseline.

## Hypothetical case

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.
